## Completion Report: Work Order 1 — Op Log (`pr-07-v2-storage-wo1`)

### Summary of Implementation

1. **Op Types & Models ([`op.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/op.go))**:
   - Defined `OpType` string enum: `add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, `split`.
   - Defined `Op` struct with fields `Type`, `EntryID`, `DossierScope`, `Timestamp`, `Source`, `SessionID`, and type-specific `Fields`.
   - Defined `OpBatch` struct with schema `Version` (1), `Ops`, `CreatedAt`, and `BatchID` (ULID).
   - Added constructors and helpers: `NewBatch`, `NewBatchWithTime`, `NewEntryID`, `NewEntryIDWithTime`.

2. **Op File I/O ([`writer.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/writer.go), [`reader.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/reader.go))**:
   - Implemented `Writer.Write(batch OpBatch)` writing indented JSON batches to `.memory/ops/<yyyy-mm>/<batch-id>.json`, creating month directories as needed.
   - Implemented `Reader.ReadBatch(path string)` for reading and validating batches from disk.

3. **Op Log Iterator ([`iterator.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/iterator.go))**:
   - Implemented `Reader.Iterate(ctx context.Context) iter.Seq2[*OpBatch, error]` traversing month directories and ULID batch files in chronological order.
   - Implemented `Reader.IterateAfter(ctx context.Context, afterBatchID string)` for incremental processing.
   - Implemented `Reader.IterateBefore(ctx context.Context, beforeCommit string)` resolving git commit cutoff timestamps via `git log -1 --format=%cI <commit>` for time-cut replays.

4. **Validation ([`validate.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/validate.go))**:
   - Implemented `ValidateOp(op Op)` enforcing requirements for all 6 op types (`add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, `split`).
   - Implemented `ValidateBatch(batch OpBatch)` validating batch version, ID, timestamp, and contained ops with informative error messages.

   - Implemented `MigrateV1Events(eventsDir, archiveDir string)` moving `.memory/events/` to `.memory/archive/v1-events/`.
   - Added `// Deprecated: use internal/core/ops instead. Will be removed in WO5.` to `internal/core/events/doc.go`.

6. **Test Suite ([`ops_test.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/ops_test.go))**:
   - Verified valid and invalid test cases across all op types.

   - Verified chronological iteration across months and incremental `IterateAfter`.
   - Verified `IterateBefore` commit cutoff timestamp resolution.
   - Verified `MigrateV1Events` directory relocation.
